headline: Grok Bot 用「人格」代替聊天线程，Muse Wonder 视频模型上线 Vercel 网关
bullets: Peter Yang 说 Grok Bot 是他现在最喜欢的 agent：不是聊天线程，而是按「人格」分工，像雇员工一样各管一摊。
Muse Wonder 模型上了 Vercel AI Gateway，但 Wonder Full 版本没上 API，Dan Shipper 吐槽它生成的视频全是澳洲口音。
Rauchg 吐槽 coding CLI 越做越复杂，顺手推了一个 6MB、毫秒级启动、模型无关的极简 CLI，内置 MCP、Skills、Subagents 和 ACP。
Levie 认为 Meta 全力冲前沿会让模型进步更快、token 更便宜；他还看好 agent 集群在网络安全里大规模跑攻击排列组合。
Aditya Agarwal 指出前沿实验室员工和顶级 AI 组织用 AI 的方式差距很大，这里面藏着一个做「横向加速器」的公司机会。
sentiment: 整体偏兴奋和看好，builder 们对 agent 架构（人格化、集群、自选 harness）和模型价格下降很乐观，同时夹杂对 CLI 越做越复杂、视频模型不稳定的吐槽。

posts.name: Peter Yang
posts.text:
Here's a clip of me explaining why Grok @bot is my favorite agent right now.

tl;dr It’s built on personas instead of chat threads, so it really feels like hiring employees to work for you. Each owns a specific job:

→ Behind the Growth owns customer support
→ YouTube Producer owns research and prep
→ Loving Husband owns errands for my family
→ Health Coach keeps my workouts on track

📌 Watch my latest Grok Bot video covering how I'm using its new features here (free X access, its own email, and Opus): https://t.co/eu1nBVXqyd
posts.summaryZh: 他解释为什么 Grok Bot 是他现在最喜欢的 agent：基于人格而非聊天线程，像雇员工，各自负责客服、研究、跑腿、健身等具体工作。

posts.name: Aaron Levie
posts.text:
Agent swarms are going to be a core part of many enterprise workflows in the future. The ability to throw compute at problems that you can massively parallelize will be too useful to not take advantage of. 

Cyber will be one of the biggest beneficiaries of this as it’s a space where testing vast number of permutations of attacks (without getting tired or bored) is an incredibly useful property. You have a wide search space of possible risk vectors and you generally need to be able to chain together different scenarios to achieve the exploit. 

This will become one of the biggest token uses in large enterprises given the range of IT systems, software, physical infrastructure, and data that needs to be protected at all times. Super interesting times in cyber.
posts.summaryZh: 他认为 agent 集群会成为企业工作流核心，网络安全最受益，因为可以不知疲倦地测试海量攻击排列组合，这会成为大企业最大的 token 消耗之一。

posts.name: Zara Zhang
posts.text:
I just heard the most touching AI coding story.

A friend @vicyaqingyang grew up in a modest home full of cockroaches. To turn lemons into lemonade, her mom made killing them a game.

When she told this story to another friend, that friend vibe coded a game from it. You catch cockroaches in a room and compete against Mom.

She cried while playing it.

The game isn’t technically sophisticated. Any model can build it pretty quickly now. What gives it a soul is the human story, experience, and emotion behind it.

Code is the new medium for storytelling.
posts.summaryZh: 她讲了个动人的故事：朋友小时候家里蟑螂多，妈妈把打蟑螂变成游戏，另一个朋友据此 vibe code 出一个抓蟑螂游戏，她玩哭了——代码成了讲故事的新媒介。
